name: Agentix IA – Chatbot & AI Customer Support
author: Agentix_IA

sections.description:
Agentix IA is a conversational AI platform designed for freelancers and SMEs looking to deploy custom-trained AI chatbots on their websites without writing code.

With this official integration plugin, you can easily connect your trained Agentix IA chatbot directly to your WordPress website.

Key Features

  • Fast Setup: Connect your AI chatbot in less than 15 minutes.
  • 24/7 Customer Support: Resolve frequent queries, guide visitors, and capture qualified leads automatically.
  • WooCommerce Ready: Help customers make purchase decisions and reduce abandoned carts.
  • Secure & Lightweight: Uses native script enqueuing loaded with defer to ensure zero impact on PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals.

Sign up and train your first AI assistant at Agentix IA.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress.org plugin directory, or upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to the Agentix IA tab in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your User ID and Agent ID from your Agentix IA dashboard and save the settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills to use Agentix IA?

No. Agentix IA is built as a complete no-code solution. Simply paste your User ID and Agent ID into the plugin settings.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. The script is enqueued using native WordPress functions with defer loading, ensuring that site rendering and Core Web Vitals are unaffected.

Where do I get my User ID and Agent ID?

Create a free account at panel.agentix-ia.es, configure your AI agent, and copy the identifiers from your dashboard.
